name: Modern Clinical Portfolio
reason_for_reset: The previous clinical-editorial direction was replaced after stakeholder rejection of the current visual design. V2 starts from a brighter, more spacious, contemporary portfolio system while preserving all factual content and accessibility contracts.

color.rule: Color creates orientation and warmth without implying unverified clinical status, credential weight, or care quality.

typography.display: Modern system sans display treatment, no external font dependency
typography.interface: Compact semibold labels with generous touch targets
typography.principle: Bolder and more digital than the prior dossier treatment, but still recruiter-safe and readable.

spacing.principle: Use bigger whitespace, clearer card grouping, and less document density.

layout.grid: Responsive editorial grid with single-column mobile collapse
layout.composition: Airy modern portfolio with hero gradients, glass navigation, rounded evidence blocks, and clear route journeys
layout.principle: Every route should feel like one designed product, not a set of separate templates.

shape.buttons: Pill controls for primary recruiter actions
shape.images: Soft framed portrait and content panels
shape.principle: Friendly, modern, and polished without becoming decorative healthcare clip art.

elevation.raised: 18px to 80px low-opacity shadows for hero, cards, navigation, and overlays
elevation.principle: Use depth to separate journeys and calls to action.

motion.principle: Motion remains restrained: entrance, hover, menu, and form states only. No scroll hijacking, looping decoration, or constant motion.

design_style.visual_thesis: A bright, contemporary nursing portfolio with calm medical credibility, recruiter clarity, and warmer human presence.
design_style.interaction_thesis: Every interaction should help navigation, contact, reading, or verification. Decorative interaction is rejected.
design_style.composition: Large hero typography, soft gradient fields, floating rounded navigation, clear journey cards, readable article layouts, and calmer verification blocks

visual_effects.threejs_decision: Rejected again: no meaningful information benefit, added bundle cost, maintenance burden, and accessibility risk.
visual_effects.reduced_motion: All content remains visible and usable with spatial animation disabled.
